g.text: All 8 fits: exact target graph, zero false/missed edges, no observable repair classes, zero invalid states.

g.text: Training: 128 of 472 / 1,304 N12 positives. Acquisition: 32 from each complement (344 / 1,176 boards).

g.text: D4 adds an explicit invariance prior and 256 attempted correlated views. No target positives or target-driven selection.

text.style: font-size: 10.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Full seen N13 capacity, two complete supports; all 8 distinct fit records retained. No new GPU search.

text.style: font-size: 10.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: The failed benefit endpoint is preserved; passing safety and reliability does not rescue the conjunctive hypothesis.

text.style: font-size: 10.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Whole stage: 21.653 CPU s / 18.648 GPU-worker s / 13.114 wall s. Both GPUs ran advancing fit queues.
